headline: We're a small photography studio in Stockholm.
subtext: Two of us, working on long-form projects across editorial, portrait, and architectural work. Click any line on this page to change it.
bio_body: Most projects start with a visit and a long phone call. We shoot in passes, weeks apart — the light isn't the same in November as it is in March. You'll see a first selection within the season and a finished edit the next. This is also a demo: edit anything you see, switch back to the home page, and your changes will still be there.
contact_body: Or open the dashboard to manage your pages, photos, and services in one place.
